summary: Comprehensive testing of Continuous Meal Planning feature. All backend APIs working correctly: POST /api/meal-preferences saves preferences with is_active flag, GET /api/meal-preferences returns saved preferences, POST /api/weekly-plan/generate-next generates next week's plan using saved preferences and excludes previously used recipes. Frontend shows 'Continuous Meal Planning Active' banner and 'Generate Next Week' button when preferences are active. Recipe Detail Modal format preserved.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Continuous Meal Planning feature fully tested and working. Key endpoints: POST /api/meal-preferences (saves preferences with is_active flag), GET /api/meal-preferences (returns preferences), POST /api/weekly-plan/generate-next (generates next week plan using saved preferences, excludes used recipes), GET /api/weekly-plan/current (returns current week plan and preferences). Recipe exclusion works via used_recipes MongoDB collection.
